entities.name: Multicast Control Channel
entities.description: Channel used for transmitting multicast control information periodically with configurable repetition period and transmission window.

entities.name: PDCCH addressed to MCCH-RNTI
entities.description: Physical Downlink Control Channel transmissions indicating MCCH transmissions, associated radio resources, and MCS.

entities.name: searchspaceMCCH
entities.description: Parameter indicating the common search space for determining PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH transmission.

entities.name: PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH
entities.description: Time instances where UE monitors PDCCH for MCCH message reception, determined based on searchspaceMCCH or SIB1 monitoring occasions.

entities.name: Synchronization Signal Block
entities.description: Transmitted SSBs used in mapping to PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception.

entities.name: MCCH transmission window
entities.description: Configured window during which MCCH information is transmitted periodically.

entities.name: searchspaceMCCH set to zero
entities.description: Condition where PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception are the same as for SIB1.

entities.name: searchspaceMCCH not set to zero
entities.description: Condition where PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message are determined based on search space indicated by searchspaceMCCH.

relations.description: MCCH transmissions are indicated via PDCCH addressed to MCCH-RNTI.
PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH transmission are determined according to the common search space indicated by searchspaceMCCH.
If searchspaceMCCH is set to zero, PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception are the same as for SIB1.
If searchspaceMCCH is not set to zero, PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message are determined based on search space indicated by searchspaceMCCH.
PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message are mapped to transmitted SSBs using a specific numbering formula.
PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message are sequentially numbered from one in the MCCH transmission window.
